snippet.title: The Industrial Clamp Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
What is one's purpose if they cannot fulfil the one they were created for? 
Help Clamp, a defective robot, escape a life in the company scrapyard and find new meaning within themselves in this easy-to-pick-up 2D platformer with light puzzles!

The Industrial Clamp will be launching on STEAM and Itch.io at some point in the future. :)
